blocks.text: San Francisco, United States—Apple on Tuesday unveiled HomeView, a voice-driven smart display built around its revamped Siri AI assistant, as the iPhone maker makes a fresh bid for a place in living rooms and kitchens. The device, which pairs a square 7-inch touchscreen with a speaker base, will sell for $299 in the United States starting November 13. Apple has struggled for years to gain ground in the smart home, where its HomePod speakers have trailed Amazon’s Alexa and Google devices.
